user.title: Connect to the inverter proxy
user.description:
Enter the proxy address. Home Assistant checks that the proxy is reachable, reads the inverter address from the existing GoodWe integration, hands that address to the proxy, and then points GoodWe at the proxy instead of the inverter.

Automatic fallback: if the proxy is unavailable for longer than the configured delay and the inverter itself still answers, Home Assistant temporarily points GoodWe back to the inverter so you keep seeing its status. When the proxy returns, Home Assistant switches back automatically. Removing this integration restores the original GoodWe address.

The control URL and token are optional; they enable the Start/Stop/Reboot/Shutdown buttons for the proxy server.

data.inverter_host: Inverter IP address (override, normally detected automatically)
data.control_token: Proxy server control token (optional, stored in Home Assistant only)
data.fallback_after_seconds: Fall back to inverter after proxy is unreachable (seconds)

error.configure_failed: The proxy did not accept the inverter address.
error.inverter_unreachable: Neither the GoodWe integration address nor the proxy's configured inverter address answered. Enter the inverter IP address manually.
